node.title: Re: How to test for empty hash?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The node [id://11104607] also briefly discusses this. In short, a hash in boolean context returns a false value when it is empty, so if (!%hash) will portably detect an empty hash. To portably get the number of keys in a hash, use [doc://keys] in scalar context; scalar(%hash) is not backwards compatible for counting keys (as the documentation [id://11135632|quoted] by [LanX] explains).

Minor edits clarification.
